authorized_scope: Governance recording ONLY of the human decision naming the final development block and the final algorithm family, together with the already-locked development configuration for that family. This authorization does NOT cover refitting any model on full development, producing a trained final-model artifact, tuning, calibration, threshold search, bootstrap, SHAP, prediction, computing any new metric/CI/p-value, executing or closing Holm, reading any row-level scientific data, accessing or unlocking the Final Test, starting Stage130, or marking this PR ready or merging it.
human_decision_translation: The final development block is M1. The selected algorithm is regularized logistic regression with the locked configuration logistic__C_0.1. The basis of the selection is a human decision on pre-locked development evidence. This is not an inferential superiority claim, not a tested superiority, not a Holm result and not a statistical proof.

superseded_marker.previous_value_meaning: The read-only audit found no frozen rule determining the block or the algorithm, and therefore required a separate human decision. That finding was correct and remains the historical record.
superseded_marker.resolved_value_meaning: The required human decision has now been made. It does not create the frozen rule the audit looked for; it exercises human governance judgement on pre-locked development evidence, which is why the basis is recorded as HUMAN_DECISION_BASED_ON_PRELOCKED_DEVELOPMENT_EVIDENCE and not as a rule-derived determination.

why_this_is_not_an_inferential_claim: No hypothesis test selected this model. The confirmatory model-comparison family (confirmatory_family_1) was never executed, the adjacent-block family was never adjusted, and no p-value exists for any of its members. The development evidence this decision rests on was locked before the decision and is quoted, not recomputed. Presenting the selection as a tested or statistically proven superiority would assert an inference the study never performed.
